paite: Siria kumpipa sepaih heutu Naaman, TOUPA'N Siriate humbitpa a azat ziak in, apu ngaih in thupi leh zahtakhuaitak ahi. Amah mihat ahi lai a, himahleh aphak hi.
heading: Naaman Hihdamna

paite: Siriate apawlpawl in akuankhia ua, Israel gam a pan numei naupangnou khat sal in ahon pi ua; ama'n Naaman zi nna asem hi.
Ama'n api kiang ah, "Samaria a om zawlnei kiang ah ka toupa va hohleh chi na ing e! Ama'n aphakna na hihdamsak ding hi a,” achi hi.
Mi khat ava lut a, atoupa kiang ah, "Israel gam a numei naupangnou in huchibang khachibang in agen," chi in apu ahilh hi.
Siria kumpipa'n, "Va hoh hen aw, Israel kumpipa kiang ah lai ka khak ding,” achi hi. Huchi in apawt a, dangkasik talent sawm leh dangka-eng khal sangguk leh silh-le-ten kikhenna ding sawm akeng hi.
Huai laikhak Israel kumpipa ava pia a, huai ah hiai akigelh hi, “Hiai lai na mu dia, ngai in, ka sikha Naaman aphakna na hihdamsak ding in na kiang ah ka hon sawl hi,” chih.

Israel kumpipa'n huai lai asim a, hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, "Mite that thei a, hingsak nawn thei Pathian hia ka hih? Hiai mi in phak hihdam dia ka kiang ah ahon sawl mawkmawk. Ngaihtuah unla, ka tung ah thusia azong hi, chih thei dih ua," achi hi.

Pathian mipa Elisha in Israel kumpipa'n apuan abotkek chih ana zak in, hichi ahong hi a, "Bangziak a na puan botkek na hia? Ka kiang ah hong paileh ake, huchi in Israel gam ah zawlnei a-om chih athei mai ding," va chi ding in kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Huchi in asakolte leh akangtalaite toh Naaman ava hoh a, Elisha inn kongbul ah ava dingh hi.
Elisha in, "Jordan lui ah sagihvei va kisil inla, na sa in ngeina apu nawn dia, huchi in na siangta ding," chi ding in mi asawl hi.

Himahleh, Naaman aheh mahmah a, apaikhia a, “Ngai un, amah mah ka kiang a hong pawt dia, ahong dingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min asam dia, ka phakna tung ah akhut akoih dia, ka phak damsak ding ei ve, chi mah hi veng in," achi hi.
"Israel gam lui tengteng sang in Damaskas kho luite, Abana leh Pharpar ahoihzaw kei a hia? Huaite a kisil in ka siangthou thei kei dia hia?" achi hi. Huchi in akilehhei a, heh mahmah in apai hi.

Asikhate'n ava naih ua, ava houpih ua, "Ka pa aw, zawlnei in thil haksatak hon hihsak dekleh leng na hihmai kei dia hia? Va kisil inla, hong siangthou in, achih pen hih zawk tuak lua hilou maw?" achi uhi.
Huchi in ahohsuk a, Pathian mipa gen bang in Jordan lui ah sagihvei ava kidiah a; huchi in asa naungek sa bang ahong hi nawn a, ahong siangta hi.

Amah leh aheute tengteng Pathian mipa kiang ah akik nawn ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, Israel ah lou ngal leitung tengteng ah Pathian ana om kei, chih ka theita. Huaiziak in tu in na sikha vualzawlna la ding in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n, "Akiang a ka omna TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah ka la kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in ama'n la ding in angen a; himahleh ala ut kei bikbek hi.

Naaman in, "Ahihkeileh, kei na sikha sabiltung nih puak khop leitang hon lasak in. Tuban siah kei na sikha in TOUPA kiang kia ah ngal lou halmang thillat leh kithoihna himhim pathian dangte kiang ah ka lan nawn het kei ding hi.
Hiai thil ah TOUPA'N na sikha ngaidam hen. Rimmon inn a be dia ka ban a kingai a ka toupa alut chiang a, kei leng ka kun sam angaih chiang in TOUPA'N hon ngaidam hen," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a pan apawt a, gamla lou apaikhe man hi.

Himahleh Pathian mipa Elisha sikha Gehazi in, "Ngai in, ka pu in Siria mi Naaman thil hon tawite la het lou in apaisak mawk a. TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka va delh dia, aneih banghiam bek ka va la ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Gehazi in Naaman adelhta hi. Naaman in kuahiam in adelh amuh in, na houpih ding in kangtalai a pan akumkhia a, "Hoih vek na maw?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "Hoih vek mah e. Ka pu in, ngai in, tu mah in Ephraim tanggam a pan in zawlneite tapate lak a tangval nih ka kiang ah ahong ahong ua, amaute dangkasik talent khat leh puansilh kikhenna ding nih pia in, chih gen ding in ahong sawl hi," achi hi.
Naaman in, "Khamuang inla, talent nih la ve," achi hi. Huchi in la ding in angen a, dangkasik talent nih puansilh kikhenna ding nih toh ip nih ah athun a, asikhate nih aposak a, ama ah apaipihta uhi.
Tang ava tun un alaksak a, insung ah akoih a; huchi in mite apaisakta hi.
Amah alut a, apu ma ah ava dingh hi. Elisha in akiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia, Gehazi?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikha koimah ah ka hoh kei," achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang mu dia kangtalai a pan huai mi ahong kum lai in ka lungtang na kiang ah apai kei maw? Sum, puansilhte, olive huante, grephuante, belamte, bawngtalte, sikhapate leh sikhanute lak hun ahi a hia?
Huaiziak in Naaman phak nang ah abelh dia, tangtawn in na suante ah leng abelh ding," achi hi. Huchi in a-omna a pan vuk bang a ngou in phaksa in apaikheta hi.
